notes.title: Thank You Bonsai
notes.content: [p][/p][p][b]With the launch of [i]The Upper Hand[/i], we want to take a moment to shout out the incredible team behind the game—starting with our coder, Bonsai.[/b] 🧠💻[/p][p]From late nights to bug fixes, Bonsai put in an incredible amount of work to bring our systems and gameplay to life. Without his tireless effort and dedication, this project wouldn't have been possible.[/p][p]Check out his original work and show him some love: [/p][p][url="https://bonsaiboys.itch.io/"]https://bonsaiboys.itch.io/[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you, Bonsai, for helping make our first game a reality. 🙏🎮[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128550/bfcbba539c8fd80406e7ea131980d651f74a96d2.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Game is out now!!!!!!!!!!!
notes.content: [p]The Upper Hand is official out of early access, with this complete we can say thank you all for the support and hope that you will play our game and let us know what you think. Have fun and enjoy!!![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128550/f4e081167e9144063b6ecc80119f79f417947e3a.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Almost Time!!!!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128550/4d858d6af0cd18d6a5cb06590b5827b89d102d43.png"][/img]The Upper Hand is now in its final push to launch! We should have a launch date to announce very soon, our art team is hard at work polishing up the final game assets and we can’t wait for you to see what we have in store If you haven’t already wishlist today to be notified of when it goes live! For those of you new to the community, The Upper Hand is a Deck Builder platforming game. As Gen0 you will go from world to world overcoming unique obstacles as you try to escape from earth. Complete challenges in each world to earn more cards and customization options as you pave your own path. We would love to hear any feedback about our game and hope you love it as much as we loved working on it![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128550/1670ae629853ab33b9995545564ad2834f5e82fb.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128550/acb9f497a643dbbd9ffae0a52ec6d1a4673a680e.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 1.0 Release!
notes.content:
Upper Hand Launches into orbit this month! We are happy to announce that the 1.0 build of the game is finally completed, and that all worlds are playable. We have added many new abilities for you to try out as you progress through the game 

Thanks to everyone who has played our game and who have helped shape it along the way.  

Join Gen0 on his quest to escape earth!

notes.title: New Levels to Explore - Version .0031 Out now!
notes.content:
][u][b]Patch Notes .0031[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Our third world has arrived which includes more levels with unique challenges for you to unlock! Adapt to the new environment and obstacles to help Gen-0 escape
[*] Updated physics engine. See Gen-0 move in ways that weren’t possible before!
[*] New updated cards and effects, allowing you to have more freedom in how you approach each level
[*] Updated Evolve-a-pedia. Choose which upgrades you would like to pursue, the more challenges you complete the more you are able to unlock. Take a look at the clips within the Evolve-a-pedia to gain knowledge on the effects and help you better decide what you would like to unlock first!
[*] Quality of life updates
[*] Various Bug Fixes

If you have any feedback or suggestions of what you would like to see in our game please reach out to us on our socials or through our Steam page. Your feedback matters to us and we would love to know your thoughts!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128550/a86196a4e65ca031bbbfd41d1d8b6606b30df9c7.png[/img]

notes.title: Version .0027 Out Now
notes.content:
If you previously had a save prior to this update, you will have to delete the save to access the game. We are sorry for the inconvenience, our team is hard at work to ensure saves carry over in future updates!

[u][b]To Delete Save[/b][/u]

On title screen select [b]OPTIONS[/b]
Next select [b]DELETE SAVE[/b]

Once done you can begin enjoying The Upper Hand again. Now onto the rest of what this patch brings!

[u][b]Patch Notes .0027[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Added multiple deck save slots
[*] Added new levels to unlock in a new world!
[*] Added achievements for all world 2 stages
[*] Added pause menu
[*] Added options menu in level select for quicker adjusting of volume
[*] Various Bug Fixes

If you have any feedback or suggestions of what you would like to see in our game please reach out to us on our socials or through our Steam page. Your feedback matters to us and we would love to know your thoughts!

notes.title: Launch and Introduction
notes.content:
Hi We are Brain Syringe Studios and we aim to create fun games that are designed to recreate that old school feeling of captivating the player. We happy to present our first major project: The Upper Hand, now as this is our first project we have made a number of mistakes: The game went to full release when it should in fact be in BETA, and we are working hard to find partners to grow the awareness of our product and grow our community. So if you find your self interested grab a copy and check out our discord and feel free to leave a review, be critical as it will help us improve The Upper Hand and games we make in the future.

Yours Truly,
Brain Syringe Studios <3
